column4: Extreme heat has overwhelmed the electricity grid, causing widespread outages and public anger.
A sudden surge in energy prices is squeezing households and weakening business confidence.
Tenants across major cities have begun coordinated rent strikes as housing costs become unbearable.
Rising borrowing costs have pushed heavily mortgaged households into severe financial distress.
Rapid automation-driven layoffs have triggered protests and a backlash against the technology sector.
A convincing fabricated video has spread nationwide, damaging trust in government and digital media.
Overloaded border facilities can no longer process arrivals safely or promptly, inflaming political tensions.
Hospitals are overwhelmed by winter demand, leaving patients waiting and staff under extreme pressure.
